title: Filtered colimits of injective etale sheaves are Gamma-acyclic
statement: Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $I$ be a small filtered category and $J:I\to\mathrm{Ab}(Y_{\mathrm{et}})$ a diagram of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with every $J_i$ injective. For every $n\geq0$, $R^{n+1}\Gamma(Y,\varinjlim_I J)=0$, where derived global sections are as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology].

source.place: Tag 0739, final claim and its proof; application to qcqs etale objects as in spaces-cohomology.tex, Tag 073E

proof.text: Set B to the qcqs objects of the small etale site and Cov to the finite covering families whose base and members are in B. Use the already proved source-library exists_finite_affine_of_mem_smallEtaleTopology to refine every covering sieve on U in B, and lift its finite index into the coefficient universe. Each refinement morphism in the generated sieve factors through a member of the original family. Affine members are qcqs; compactSpace_and_quasiSeparatedSpace_piObj gives qcqs iterated fibre products. This supplies hcover, hB and hcofinal of the Cech criterion.

For every member of every Cech nerve in Cov, transfer the module-valued sections theorem through the equivalence between modules over the lifted integers and abelian groups. The induced equivalence of sheaf categories preserves the colimit, and its counit identifies the two image cocones. Thus evaluation on every nerve member preserves the filtered colimit. Apply the finite Cech homology preservation theorem in degree p.

Each object J_i is injective, so the existing injective Cech acyclicity theorem makes its positive Cech homology zero. The diagram after the Cech homology functor is therefore a zero functor. Its image colimit cocone from step 2 has zero vertex by IsColimit.isZero_pt.

Apply the stated Cech vanishing criterion with these B, Cov and the Cech vanishing from step 3. Evaluate at the terminal identity etale object, which is qcqs by the hypotheses on Y. The global-sections/evaluation natural isomorphism induces an isomorphism of right derived functors: apply NatTrans.rightDerived to its hom and inv; the composition and identity laws prove that they are inverse. Transport the IsZero across its component at colimit J.
